name: StartupOffInWindows
en: Turned off in Settings > Apps > Startup. Turn it on there
ar: غير مفعَّل في إعدادات Windows. يمكنك تفعيله من الإعدادات > التطبيقات > بدء التشغيل.
where: main settings list, Store version only, under the switch when Windows Settings or Task Manager turned the app's startup off; only the person can turn it back on there

name: StartupOffByPolicy
en: Off because your organization manages this setting
ar: غير مفعَّل لأن مؤسستك تدير هذا الإعداد
where: main settings list, Store version only, under the switch when a policy keeps the app's startup off

name: StartupOnByPolicy
en: On because your organization manages this setting
ar: مفعَّل لأن مؤسستك تدير هذا الإعداد
where: main settings list, Store version only, under the switch when a policy keeps the app's startup on
